# About this modpack

**OptiThunder** is a lightweight modpack based on Fabric, designed to deliver best performance and Quality-of-Life features, while being absolutely vanilla!

Featuring [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) and other performance mods this modpack can deliver 1000+ FPS on a midrange PC.

Currently in beta stage but already provides a solid performance and experience.
